items.question: What is SeaDays?
items.answer: SeaDays is a cruise planning and travel companion app that helps travelers organize voyages, discover ships and ports, connect with fellow cruisers, and track maritime milestones—all in one beautifully designed mobile experience.

items.question: Who can use SeaDays?
items.answer: SeaDays is designed for anyone who cruises or plans to cruise—from first-time sailors to experienced travelers managing multiple voyages. The app is available on Android and iOS.

items.question: Can journalists use the logos?
items.answer: Yes. Journalists, bloggers, and media outlets may use official SeaDays logos and assets when reporting on or referencing SeaDays. Assets must not be altered beyond standard scaling and must include attribution where appropriate.

items.question: Where can media request interviews?
items.answer: Media interview requests can be sent to press@seadays.app. Please include your publication, deadline, and topic. Our team will respond as quickly as possible.

items.question: How can reviewers contact SeaDays?
items.answer: Product reviewers and app publications can reach us at press@seadays.app for review access, assets, and spokesperson availability. Technical support questions should go to support@seadays.app.
